title-large.purpose: The Make my sticker latch and the stash heading.

title.purpose: Well titles (ketchup) and the lid title (navy).

emphasis.purpose: Promise, tag price, stickers-left count, placeholder copy, thumb +/- glyphs.

button.purpose: Enamel and ketchup buttons, size name, loading copy.

label.purpose: Field labels, hints, chips, tag, badge, status strip, summary rows.

caption.purpose: Size dimensions, per-sheet counts, history labels. Tabular figures.

shadows.name: well
shadows.purpose: Every white enamel well and the lid actions well.

shadows.name: lid-recess
shadows.purpose: The sky lid face. Stash interior and sheet bench use inset 0 3px 8px rgba(16, 48, 74, 0.4).

shadows.name: shadow-sticker
shadows.purpose: Every sticker on the lid, in the stash and in the edit modal.

shadows.name: shadow-box
shadows.purpose: The lunchbox on the cloth, after its chrome rim rings.

shadows.name: shadow-modal
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, after an inset chrome rim and an 8px ketchup ring.

shadows.name: chrome-rim
shadows.purpose: Handle and nameplate rim; the box uses 4px/6px, the latch 4px/5px.

shadows.name: hardware-lip

shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: The A4 sheet on the sky bench.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every state change: border, background, colour, transform on press. 120 to 220ms.

motion.name: ease-slap
motion.purpose: Anything that lands: stickers, the active chip, stash hover, modal entry. 160 to 480ms.

motion.name: slap
motion.value: 480ms ease-slap; from scale(1.22) rotate(-9deg) opacity 0; 60% opacity 1; to scale(1) rotate(-3deg)
motion.purpose: A new design landing on the lid.

motion.name: slapFlat
motion.value: 420ms ease-slap; from scale(1.3) rotate(-8deg) opacity 0; to none
motion.purpose: A sticker placed on the A4 sheet.

motion.name: micPulse
motion.value: 1.2s ease-out infinite; scale 1 to 1.5, opacity 0.9 to 0
motion.purpose: Listening ring around the mustard mic.

motion.name: plot
motion.value: 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; translateY 0 to 202px and back
motion.purpose: Mustard plotter bar on the loading sticker.

motion.name: modal-enter
motion.value: 280ms ease-slap; from translateY(14px) scale(0.98); overlay 220ms ease-out

components.name: Latch
components.description: The make action: ketchup gradient with chrome rim and a 5px lip. Press drops 4px.
components.css: .ds-latch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 60px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; font-family: 'Lilita One', 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.375rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #FFFFFF; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #D8232F 0%, #D8232F 55%, #A9161F 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28), 0 0 0 4px #D5DBE1, 0 0 0 5px #5C6670, 0 5px 0 5px #5C6670, 0 12px 18px -8px rgba(30,27,24,0.6); cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-latch:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #A9161F 0%, #A9161F 55%, #8C1119 100%); } .ds-latch:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.3), 0 0 0 4px #D5DBE1, 0 0 0 5px #5C6670, 0 1px 0 5px #5C6670, 0 4px 8px -6px rgba(30,27,24,0.6); } .ds-latch:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F3B41B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Order Button
components.description: Ketchup fill with a 2px ketchup-deep lip. Order a sheet, Submit order.
components.css: .ds-btn-order { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; color: #FFFFFF; background: #D8232F; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25), 0 2px 0 #A9161F, 0 6px 10px -6px rgba(30,27,24,0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-order:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #A9161F; } .ds-btn-order:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #A9161F; } .ds-btn-order:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-order:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F3B41B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Enamel Button
components.description: White enamel with an inset chrome ring and a 2px chrome lip. New, Edit, Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-enamel { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; color: #1E1B18; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #D5DBE1, 0 2px 0 #8E98A3; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-enamel:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #8E98A3, 0 2px 0 #5C6670; } .ds-btn-enamel:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #8E98A3; } .ds-btn-enamel:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F3B41B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Style Chip
components.description: Style picker. The active chip fills mustard, tilts -2deg and scales 1.04 with ease-slap.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 9px 6px; border: 2px solid #D5DBE1; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1E1B18; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #8E98A3; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip-active { border-color: #C58A08; background: #F3B41B; transform: rotate(-2deg) scale(1.04); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px -4px rgba(30,27,24,0.45); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F3B41B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White enamel with a 2px chrome border. Focus turns the border mustard with a mustard-soft halo.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="A puppy in sunglasses at the beach">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 2px solid #D5DBE1; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1E1B18; font-family: 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.4; caret-color: #D8232F; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5A544D; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #8E98A3; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #F3B41B; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #FBE7A8; }

components.name: Language Toggle and Mic
components.description: Segmented EN/ES on an enamel-2 track plus a 38px chrome mic. Active language and listening mic are mustard.
components.css: .ds-lang { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #F1F4F7; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #D5DBE1; } .ds-lang-btn { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 7px 11px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #5A544D; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-lang-btn:hover { color: #1E1B18; } .ds-lang-active { background: #F3B41B; color: #1E1B18; } .ds-mic { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #D5DBE1 45%, #8E98A3 55%, #D5DBE1 100%); color: #1E1B18; display: grid; place-items: center; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #5C6670, 0 2px 0 #5C6670; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-mic svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-mic:hover { background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-mic:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #5C6670; } .ds-mic-listening { background: #F3B41B; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #C58A08, 0 2px 0 #C58A08; } .ds-mic-listening::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border: 2px solid #F3B41B; border-radius: inherit; animation: ds-mic-pulse 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-mic-pulse { from { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.9; } to { transform: scale(1.5); opacity: 0; } } .ds-lang-btn:focus-visible, .ds-mic:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F3B41B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sticker on the Lid
components.description: Sky enamel lid face with sunburst; the design is a white-bordered sticker tilted -3deg that slaps in with ease-slap.
components.css: .ds-lid { padding: 14px; border-radius: 18px; background-color: #4FA8E0; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.28), rgba(255,255,255,0) 45%), repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 46%, rgba(255,255,255,0.16) 0deg 9deg, rgba(255,255,255,0) 9deg 18deg); box-shadow: inset 0 3px 8px rgba(16,48,74,0.45), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.3); display: grid; gap: 12px; justify-items: center; } .ds-lid-title { justify-self: start; font-family: 'Lilita One', 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1.2; color: #10304A; margin: 0; } .ds-sticker { padding: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(30,27,24,0.12), 0 10px 20px -8px rgba(30,27,24,0.45); transform: rotate(-3deg); animation: ds-slap 480ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) both; margin: 12px 0 18px; } .ds-sticker-art { width: 160px; height: 160px; border-radius: 12px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #FBE7A8, #F3B41B 55%, #D8232F 100%); } @keyframes ds-slap { from { transform: scale(1.22) rotate(-9deg); opacity: 0; } 60% { opacity: 1; } to { transform: scale(1) rotate(-3deg); opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Tray Well
components.description: White enamel well recessed with an inner shadow, no border, Lilita One title in ketchup.
components.html: Size
components.css: .ds-well { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px 16px 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(30,27,24,0.18), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-well-title { font-family: 'Lilita One', 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1.2; color: #D8232F; margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-size-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; } .ds-size { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 2px solid #D5DBE1; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; text-align: left; font-family: 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #1E1B18; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-size:hover { border-color: #8E98A3; } .ds-size:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-size-active { border-color: #C58A08; background: #F3B41B; } .ds-size-name { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-size-dims { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: #5A544D; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-size-active .ds-size-dims { color: #1E1B18; } .ds-size:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F3B41B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: A4 Sheet
components.description: One continuous white A4 at 210/297 on the sky bench. Empty slots are faint dashed guides; a placed sticker slaps flat.
components.html: 1 / 4 filled
components.css: .ds-bench { width: 220px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 18px; background-color: #4FA8E0; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.24), rgba(255,255,255,0) 50%), repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.14) 0deg 9deg, rgba(255,255,255,0) 9deg 18deg); box-shadow: inset 0 3px 8px rgba(16,48,74,0.4); } .ds-sheet { aspect-ratio: 210 / 297; width: 100%; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(30,27,24,0.1), 0 10px 18px -10px rgba(16,48,74,0.6); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 47.619%); column-gap: 0.952%; row-gap: 0.673%; justify-content: center; align-content: center; } .ds-slot { aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1.5px dashed rgba(30,27,24,0.22); border-radius: 9%; overflow: hidden; } .ds-slot-filled { border-color: transparent; padding: 5%; } .ds-slot-art { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 7%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(30,27,24,0.08); background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #FBE7A8, #F3B41B 55%, #D8232F 100%); animation: ds-slap-flat 420ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) both; } @keyframes ds-slap-flat { from { transform: scale(1.3) rotate(-8deg); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } } .ds-slots { margin: 10px 0 0; text-align: center; font-family: 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; color: #10304A; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Nameplate
components.description: Riveted mustard nameplate under the red handle, chrome rim, Lilita One in ketchup-ink.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: grid; justify-items: center; padding: 8px 12px 12px; } .ds-handle { width: 232px; height: 42px; border-radius: 21px; position: relative; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #EE4A54 0%, #D8232F 55%, #A9161F 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35), 0 0 0 3px #D5DBE1, 0 0 0 4px #5C6670, 0 6px 12px -6px rgba(30,27,24,0.5); } .ds-handle::before, .ds-handle::after, .ds-nameplate::before, .ds-nameplate::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #FFFFFF, #D5DBE1 45%, #5C6670); } .ds-handle::before, .ds-handle::after { width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: -6px; } .ds-handle::before { left: 14px; } .ds-handle::after { right: 14px; } .ds-nameplate { position: relative; margin-top: -6px; padding: 12px 38px 10px; background: #F3B41B; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55), 0 0 0 3px #D5DBE1, 0 0 0 4px #5C6670, 0 8px 14px -8px rgba(30,27,24,0.5); } .ds-nameplate::before, .ds-nameplate::after { width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-top: -4.5px; } .ds-nameplate::before { left: 12px; } .ds-nameplate::after { right: 12px; } .ds-nameplate h1 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Lilita One', 'Baloo 2', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 1.2rem + 2vw, 2.5rem); line-height: 1; color: #8C1119; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55); white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
The page is an open illustrated metal lunchbox lying on a sky gingham tablecloth. The box is ketchup red enamel with a chrome rim and four corner rivets. Its two hard halves are joined by a vertical chrome hinge: the tray on the left is white enamel with molded wells where the kid describes, picks a style and a size, and presses the latch; the lid on the right is sky enamel with a printed sunburst, and that is where the sticker sticks. Above the box a chrome handle arcs over a riveted mustard nameplate. Below it the sticker stash is a second enamel tin with a sky interior.

Everything a kid reads is set in Baloo 2; everything printed on the tin (nameplate, compartment titles, the latch, prices, modal headings) is Lilita One. Every design is shown as a sticker: a thick white kiss-cut border, tilted -3deg, that slaps onto the lid with an overshoot. Mustard is the one live colour; it appears only where something is selected, listening, in use, or focused. The world replaces the rejected print-shop cutting table (sage mat, CutContour magenta, Bricolage Grotesque) and the earlier purple SaaS look wholesale.
keyCharacteristics: Ketchup enamel box with chrome rim and rivets on a sky gingham cloth
Two hard halves, tray and lid, joined by a chrome hinge; never two equal cards
Mustard alone owns every live and selected state
Lilita One tin lettering, Baloo 2 for reading
Every design is a white-bordered sticker tilted -3deg that slaps into place
Hardware has thickness: latch, buttons, rim and nameplate are drawn with chrome lips and pressed states

rules.name: The Mustard Is Live Rule
rules.body: Mustard means selected, listening, in use or focused. It never fills a resting surface other than the nameplate and the stickers-left badge, and no other colour marks a live state.

rules.name: The Two Halves Rule
rules.body: Tray and lid are different materials: white enamel wells with an inner shadow versus sky enamel with a sunburst. They are never styled as two matching cards.

rules.name: The Tin Print Rule
rules.body: Lilita One is reserved for what would be printed on the tin: nameplate, compartment titles, the latch, prices and modal headings. It is never used for sentences, buttons other than the latch, or labels.

rules.name: The Recess or Rim Rule
rules.body: A surface is either recessed (inner shadow, no border) or hardware (chrome rim or lip, outer shadow). Nothing carries both an inner recess and an outer drop shadow.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: A pressed control moves down by exactly its lip (2px buttons, 3px modal latch, 4px main latch) and its lip disappears. Hover never lifts; it darkens the fill or the border.

dos: Do show every design as a white-bordered sticker tilted -3deg with the sticker shadow, and land it with slap (ease-slap, 480ms) on the lid or slapFlat (420ms) on the sheet.
Do keep mustard for live and selected states only: active chip, size, language, listening mic, in-use thumb, focus ring, nameplate and stickers-left badge.
Do set tin lettering (nameplate, compartment titles, latch, prices, modal titles) in Lilita One 400 and everything else in Baloo 2 at 400, 600, 700 or 800.
Do draw pressable hardware with a chrome rim or lip and press it down by its lip height; recess resting surfaces with an inner shadow.
Do keep the A4 at 210/297 with 33.333% or 47.619% slots drawn as faint dashed guides on one continuous sheet.
donts: Don't style tray and lid as two equal cards; the tray is white enamel wells, the lid is sky enamel with a sunburst.
Don't use a pill except the handle (21px on 42px); every other shape is a rounded square between 2px and 26px.
Don't add glows, glass blur, gradients outside the enamel and chrome ramps, emoji, or icon tiles; icons are 2px stroke SVG at 18 to 20px.
Don't put a second live colour anywhere, or use ketchup for a selected state.
Don't rename or remove JS-bound ids (emailGate, gateEmail, gateContinue, paypalButtons, sheetPreviewRow, historyGrid, styleGrid, sizeGrid and the rest) when restyling.
